basis: Measured consumption on this host, plus the observed outcome of a real 3558-package cook that died.

measured_consumers_gb.pytest_basetemp_recommended_location: F: (used to keep suite scratch off C:)

evidence_for_thresholds.observation: A full 3558-package cook ran for 14 h 52 min and reached 2942/3558 packages (82.7 percent) before terminating.
evidence_for_thresholds.measured_peak_output: cook_out reached 4.94 GB at only 82.7 percent completion, with 616 packages still outstanding.
evidence_for_thresholds.inference: A COMPLETE cook of the same scope projects to roughly 4.94 / 0.827 = 5.97 GB of cooked output, and a re-cook that overwrites in place may transiently require both the old and new payload, so budget at least 2x = ~12 GB for the output directory.
evidence_for_thresholds.confidence: MEDIUM - one incomplete run, one scope

evidence_for_thresholds.observation: Engine DerivedDataCache reached 9.27 GB during cook work.
evidence_for_thresholds.inference: Shader and asset DDC for this project saturates near 10 GB. A fresh cook against a cold DDC can grow this further.
evidence_for_thresholds.confidence: HIGH - directly measured on the engine tree

evidence_for_thresholds.observation: Engine Intermediate is 21.74 GB after building ShaderCompileWorker, UnrealHeaderTool, UnrealLightmass, UE4Editor and CarlaUE4Editor.
evidence_for_thresholds.inference: A full engine rebuild is already paid for. A project-generation step (GenerateProjectFiles, never yet run) plus additional editor targets could add several GB.

evidence_for_thresholds.observation: User TEMP held 32.92 GB of pytest scratch plus 15.20 GB of regression scratch before cleanup, filling C: to 0.00 GB. That condition broke a running test session with 'There is not enough space on the disk.'
evidence_for_thresholds.inference: Test/tooling scratch is the single largest observed consumer and is entirely avoidable by relocating scratch to F:.

evidence_for_thresholds.observation: pagefile.sys (9 GB, system-managed) resides on C:, so C: free space directly constrains commit capacity. TotalVirtualSize was 56.7 GB against 47.7 GB of RAM.
evidence_for_thresholds.inference: A low C: free-space figure is a memory-pressure risk during shader compilation, not only a write-failure risk.
evidence_for_thresholds.confidence: HIGH - measured via Win32_PageFileUsage and Win32_OperatingSystem

gate_derivation.MIN_C_FREE_IMPORT_GB: 12 GB = 2x the 4.94 GB observed cook_out footprint, plus margin for import-setting temporaries and the recipe lockfile. C: also hosts pagefile.sys, so a low C: figure additionally risks commit exhaustion during shader work.
gate_derivation.MIN_E_FREE_IMPORT_GB: 8 GB. E: hosts the packaged CARLA runtime (E:\CARLA\CARLA_0.9.16) and previously held 19.85 GB of stale Recycle Bin data that consumed it to 0.25 GB. 8 GB is the floor at which a staged copy plus log growth is safe.
gate_derivation.MIN_G_FREE_IMPORT_GB: 30 GB. G: hosts the engine (Intermediate 21.74 GB + DDC 9.27 GB) and the CARLA source tree, and is the write target for a re-import.
gate_derivation.MIN_C_FREE_COOK_GB: 20 GB, higher than the import gate because cook additionally drives DDC growth (9.27 GB observed) and shader working directories on C:.
gate_derivation.MIN_E_FREE_COOK_GB: 12 GB. Cook writes cooked output and logs; E: previously proved able to reach 0.25 GB.
gate_derivation.MIN_G_FREE_COOK_GB: 45 GB, the highest gate, because a cook writes output while the engine Intermediate (21.74 GB) and DDC (9.27 GB) remain resident on the same volume.

current_gate_evaluation.verdict: A further full import would pass the storage gate. A full cook would NOT, short by 3.3 GB on G:.

preflight_check_required.rule: Refuse to start an import or cook when any gate in its class fails. Print the drive, the required gate, and the measured value.
suggested_placement: tools/preflight_import_package.py (pre-import preflight, alongside the existing offset validation)
preflight_check_required.implementation_status: NOT YET IMPLEMENTED - the thresholds are derived and recorded here, but no gate has been wired into code. Recorded as a required follow-up rather than claimed as done.

additional_recommendations: Point all pytest and tool scratch at F: (--basetemp=F:\...) so the system drive and its pagefile are never at risk. This was adopted for the baseline comparison arms in this wave.

Periodically clear %TEMP%\pytest-of-admin; it accumulated 19 run directories instead of pytest's usual 3 because a disk-full condition had prevented cleanup, creating a positive-feedback failure loop.
Treat E:\$Recycle.Bin as a monitored consumer: it held 19.85 GB of 2025-era CARLA content in this wave.
not_claimed: No gate was enforced in code; only derived and recorded.
The 12 GB output projection rests on a single incomplete cook and may change for a different map scope.
Storage was not the proven cause of the earlier cook termination; that remains unestablished (see LIVE_COOK_FINAL_STATE.json).
